description:
Bulk Prefix/Suffix Fields Name prepares the deletion of deprecated Dynamics 365 / Dataverse fields. It tags them in bulk with a prefix or a suffix on their display name (for example ZZ_ or [Deprecated]), and can clean them up everywhere they are used.

Load the tables, click one to list its renamable fields, select the fields and choose Prefix or Suffix, Add or Remove and the text. A preview column shows the new display name of each field. Every translation of the display name is updated, the comparison is case-insensitive and a prefix already present is never added twice.

With the Options toggle on, Apply can also remove the fields from forms (or hide them), system views (columns, sort, Quick Find), charts, plug-in step filtering attributes and images, relationship mappings, duplicate detection rules and field security profiles, make them optional, remove them from Advanced Find, disable their auditing and add a dated deprecation note to their description. Presets help pick the actions.

Before anything is written, a review window lists every place the fields are used, sorted by priority: calculated / rollup fields, keys, relationships, plug-in steps, business rules, workflows, cloud flows, form scripts, forms, views, charts, e-mail templates, personal views, and more. It shows what will change, what is kept and why, and how many records hold a value. A Usage button does the same analysis for one field at any time.

Safety: automatic backup of forms, views, charts, steps and labels before any change, managed components skipped, filters and single filtering attributes never removed, optional dry run, optional publish, changed components added to a solution of your choice, CSV export of the labels and of the impact report, and a result line for every operation.
releaseNotes:
2.0.0 - Complete redesign

- New Fluent interface shared with the author's other tools: cards, search boxes, Prefix/Suffix and Add/Remove chips, live preview of the new display names.
- Click a table to list its fields; multi-select, Add selected / Add all listed, Remove / Clear, keyboard shortcuts (Enter, Delete).
- Every translation of the display name is updated (other languages are no longer erased); case-insensitive comparison; no double prefix.
- The table is published automatically (optional) and every operation reports its own status and Dataverse error message.
- Options dialog: remove the fields from forms (or hide them), views, charts, plug-in steps and images, relationship mappings, duplicate detection rules and field security profiles; make them optional; remove them from Advanced Find; disable auditing; add a dated deprecation note. Presets: Recommended / All / None.
- Review window before any change: every place the fields are used, sorted by priority (High / Medium / Low), with what will change, what is kept and why; data usage of the fields in the header.
- Usage button in front of each selected field to see where it is used.
- Safety: automatic backup before apply, skip managed components, dry run, optional publish, add the changed components to a solution.
- CSV export of the current labels (all languages) and of the impact report.
- Fixes: crashes after an error, cross-thread access, duplicate selections, search with special characters, batches of more than 1,000 fields.
- Plugin assembly renamed BulkPrefixSuffixFieldsName.dll (no spaces), as expected by the XrmToolBox Tool Library.

1.1.0 - Set the selected fields non searchable.

1.0.0 - First release: prefix or suffix the display name of the selected fields.
summary: Tag deprecated Dynamics 365 / Dataverse fields with a prefix or suffix and clean them up from forms, views, steps and more, after a review of every place they are used.
title: Bulk Prefix/Suffix Fields Name
